notes: Fixed: the mobile voice test no longer fails with synthesis-failed. If the selected voice is refused, it automatically retries with the phone's default voice.
Improved: speech now prefers voices stored on the phone, so it works without mobile data.
Improved: the engine is no longer cancelled right before speaking, which Android could reject.
Improved: the male voice still falls back to a pitch-adjusted local voice when the phone has no named male voice.
Updated: the GitHub repository link points to work-reminder-app.
